data.title: Ellington Beach House
data.about:
Atop Palm Jumeirah’s tranquil east crescent lies Ellington Beach House, a new lifestyle icon. The ultra-luxurious collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments offers panoramic views of the city and captures the essence and elegance of a refined private club.

 Watch the sun rise over the Gulf and set over Dubai’s skyline as it follows the solar pathway overhead. You will find every detail in perfect harmony with your daily life. As well as offering a gorgeous view of the sea, its superyacht-inspired architecture entices you inside to discover a world of elevated character and charm like nothing else on the island.

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
An intricate network of roads connects boutique hotels, fine dining, malls, and architectural landmarks to the city center.. The full splendor of Palm Jumeirah, framed by the Dubai skyline, is best captured from the water. 

  • 01 Mins – The Boardwalk Palm Jumeirah
  • 02 Mins – Atlantis The Palm
  • 10 Mins – Nakheel Mall
  • 20 Mins – Dubai Marina
  • 25 Mins – Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa
